question: ما حقيقة تواصل النمل، وما الصلة التي يمكن بحثها مع قوله تعالى في النمل؟

evidence.text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَـٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَـٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

globalGeographicScientificDiscovery.purpose: Search worldwide scientific, documentary and social-media sources for useful factual observations, discovery documentation and visual references before composing an original encyclopedia film.
globalGeographicScientificDiscovery.selectionRule: Use the source to discover and verify facts; use a visual clip in the final film only after explicit rights evidence or a compatible public/open license is recorded.
globalGeographicScientificDiscovery.fallbackRule: When a high-value source is not reusable, preserve its citation and research value, then recreate the needed visual as an original scene instead of copying the protected footage.
globalGeographicScientificDiscovery.qualityRule: Prefer original photography, macro footage, field recordings, institutional documentation and primary scientific material over generic stock visuals when they materially improve factual fidelity.
